description: Declared mutants of the kernel batches. kernel-scaffold (docs/architecture/plans/kernel/kernel-scaffold-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 5; ids ks-): spec J-9 guard, target/naming DI 1 and 3 guard, Delta-1 link check. registry-schedule (docs/architecture/plans/kernel/registry-schedule-declaration.zh-Hant.md, sections 5 and 6; ids rs-): spec J-10 to J-47 of the batch, the J.3 priority mutants 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 11 and 14, the compile-failure samples (a) of J-10 (replacing the scaffold's sample mutants), and the writable-symbol guard (judgement 9). A mutant is killed only when its check fails with the expected message (AGENTS 14.2); every check is a common test (no product test). Run from the repository root with python3 -I -B docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/architecture/plans/kernel/scripts/mutations.json --build-dir <build dir with tests> --cmake <cmake>; the rs-sym- command mutants read the newest libgyo_kernel.a under build/ (the one the runner just rebuilt) and need nm on PATH; they run on macOS and Linux only. Later kernel batches add their mutants here.
